title: Assessment of the Efficacy of E. Coli 5C in the Management of Post-Colonoscopy Symptoms
official: Assessment of the Efficacy of E. Coli 5C in the Management of Post-colonoscopy Symptoms: a Randomised, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Trial.
summary: This prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial will evaluate the efficacy and safety of Escherichia coli 5C (Colipral®) in adult patients undergoing diagnostic colonoscopy. Participants will be randomized in a 1:1 ratio to receive either Colipral® or placebo for 14 days immediately after colonoscopy. The study aims to determine whether Colipral® reduces post-colonoscopy gastrointestinal symptoms compared with placebo, using validated symptom and stool assessment tools, patient-reported global improvement, and safety monitoring.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged between 18 and 80 years;
* Must have undergone a full colonoscopy on the date of enrolment.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chronic Inflammatory Bowel Disease
* Complicated Diverticular Disease (DICA classification \>3)
* Neoplastic disease of the colon
* Diagnosed microscopic colitis
* Therapeutic colonoscopy
* Immunocompromised patients (primary immunodeficiency, cancer undergoing active chemotherapy or immunotherapy, autoimmune disease undergoing immunosuppressive treatment)
